description: This file defines the ContactsViewDetail class in PHP, which extends a ViewDetail class and overrides the display method to manipulate portal information and include additional functionality for the Contacts module in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: ContactsViewDetail
classes.description: A PHP class extending ViewDetail that manages the display of contact details, including portal settings and PDF letter functionalities.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to control portal display options and load additional templates and settings.
